improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring criteria, such as sentiment analysis of chat messages or real-time audience engagement metrics, to improve scoring accuracy and relevance.
Enhance filtering capabilities by supporting multi-select filters and advanced query options (e.g., regex matching or range-based filters).
Upgrade data persistence to IndexedDB for better scalability and support for larger datasets, as LocalStorage may become a bottleneck for extensive data.
Include wireframes or mockups for the GUI design to provide a clearer visual representation of the user interface.
Expand smoke tests to include edge cases, such as handling extremely large datasets or invalid data formats, to ensure robustness.
Add more detailed analysis of competitors' pricing models and user retention strategies to better position the product in the market.
Include a troubleshooting section for common issues users might encounter while running the project locally.

payload.quality_target: Enhance scalability, usability, and advanced feature support.
